name: fr.liris.asioaudiounity
description: Plays Unity sounds through an ASIO driver, each sound on its own output channel, and sends their positions over OSC: with REAPER (ReaRoute) and Spat Revolution, this spatialises a Unity scene on any speaker layout. Includes the Spat OSC and REAPER OSC plugins. Windows only.

samples.description: Contains an example scene with sample sounds to demonstrate the Asio Audio Unity package functionality.
